column3: When we meet Sung Jinwoo, he's an E rank hunter. People call him the weakest hunter of all mankind.
He isn't fighting for glory. His mother is in a coma in the hospital, and he's the one looking after his younger sister. Every dangerous job is about paying the bills.
Then comes the double dungeon. A temple full of giant statues, strange rules, and almost no way out.
Jinwoo stays behind so the others can escape. And right at the edge of death, something offers him a choice. He becomes a player.
He wakes up in the hospital, and a glowing window appears in front of him. A daily quest.
One hundred push ups. One hundred sit ups. One hundred squats. And a ten kilometer run.
The first time, he ignores it. And the system drags him into the penalty zone, a desert where he has to survive giant centipedes for four hours.
So he does the quest. And when it's done, he's rewarded. Full recovery, and three stat points to spend.
And here's the part that matters. He keeps doing it. Day after day. In one episode, he even does it twice in a single day.
